patches.summary: Inject Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header from ERCOT_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY (or ERCOT_APIKEYHEADER) so requests carry both the Bearer id_token and the APIM subscription key.
patches.reason: ERCOT's spec declares apiKeyHeader and oauth2 as alternative security requirements, but the production gateway demands BOTH credentials on every call. The generator only wired the oauth2 ROPC bearer; without this patch every request returns 401 'missing subscription key'.
patches.validated_outcome: All 5 priority command groups (np6-345-cd load actual, np6-788-cd LMP, np6-905-cd SPP, np4-188-cd DAM ancillary, np3-565-cd load forecast) plus np3-233-cd outage return HTTP 200 with valid field metadata against the live API.
